concern_summary: This concern addresses the management of expense reports and related interactions on the category page, allowing users to set expense limits and providing user feedback for invalid or non-existing entries.
This concern captures the functionalities related to displaying and managing spend categories within financial policies.
Management of the confirmation page functionalities, including displaying the confirmation details and navigating to the page after successful transaction actions.
This concern revolves around rendering the confirmation page that indicates various actions were completed successfully, informing users of their actions and providing necessary navigation options.
Control over the maximum expense amount that can be claimed without a receipt for specific policy categories, including setting, updating, and nullifying this limit.
Management of expense types and receipt requirements, allowing users to select expense types and specify receipt requirements for expenses.

This concern addresses various confirmation modals throughout the application, used to prompt user confirmation for actions that may lead to irreversible changes, such as member removal or system actions.
